doc.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Farmer's German
summary: He learned German at rehearsals and admits it is poor.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: It’s embarrassing [laughs]. I can get through the day and the night, of course. I know people must, “This guy must be very ignorant if he can’t speak German any better than that.” The way you form the sentences and all that, gender, I never studied. Whatever I know I just picked it up at the rehearsals mostly because you’re rehearsing and the other fifteen guys speak German, then that’s what the conductors gonna speak. You have to grab it, grab what you can. I can deal with it, but a whole lot passes me by
